dataset: NLP development corpus after header-band table recovery; previously inspected annotations
protocol: Same 16 paired questions and two negative probes, paper-specific index, 1400-character chunks and k=3. These cases were inspected during implementation and are now DEVELOPMENT data. No generation calls. Original frozen-code results remain in results.json.

metrics.evidence_recall: annotated quote plus source-region center present in a top-k chunk
metrics.bound_cell_recall: correct parsed row label, leaf header, required parent group, value and source cell region in a top-k chunk
